# Security Checklist: Consolidación Arquitectura y Conformidad VeriFactu (AEAT)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality validation for technical debt and security concerns.
**Created**: 2026-09-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are secure persistence requirements defined for API keys/tokens (e.g., encryption, rotation) instead of plain text storage? [Completeness, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for a single, unambiguous authentication mechanism to avoid attack surface confusion? [Completeness, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the exact boundaries defined for where the `offline_simulated` Verifactu fallback is strictly prohibited? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK004 Are error handling and logging requirements explicitly defined for business operations (e.g., bank_service, mail_tools) to prevent silent failures? [Completeness, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for non-deterministic test resolution, such as the use of ephemeral fixtures instead of shared disk state? [Coverage, Spec §US3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the single "auth_router JWT unificado" authentication mechanism defined with specific implementation protocols and token lifecycle metrics? [Clarity, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the conditions under which exceptions must be registered and propagated quantified or clearly categorized? [Clarity, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK008 Can the prohibition of `offline_simulated` in production be objectively verified during deployment? [Measurability, Spec §US3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Add comments or findings inline
